def pbCanDoubleBattle?
  return true if $player.able_pokemon_count >= 2
  return $PokemonGlobal.partner && $player.able_pokemon_count >= 1
end

def pbCanTripleBattle?
  return true if $player.able_pokemon_count >= 3
  return $PokemonGlobal.partner && $player.able_pokemon_count >= 2
end

partner_selection.content:
def partner_can_participate?(foe_party)
    return false if !$PokemonGlobal.partner || $game_temp.battle_rules["noPartner"]
    return true if foe_party.length > 1
    if $game_temp.battle_rules["size"]
      return false if $game_temp.battle_rules["size"] == "single" ||
                      $game_temp.battle_rules["size"][/^1v/i]   # "1v1", "1v2", "1v3", etc.
      return true
    end
    return false
  end

  # Generate information for the player and partner trainer(s)
  def set_up_player_trainers(foe_party)
    trainer_array = [$player]
    ally_items    = []
    pokemon_array = $player.party
    party_starts  = [0]
    if partner_can_participate?(foe_party)
      ally = NPCTrainer.new($PokemonGlobal.partner[1], $PokemonGlobal.partner[0])
      ally.id    = $PokemonGlobal.partner[2]
      ally.party = $PokemonGlobal.partner[3]
      data = GameData::Trainer.try_get($PokemonGlobal.partner[0], $PokemonGlobal.partner[1], $PokemonGlobal.partner[2])
      ally_items[1] = data&.items.clone || []
      trainer_array.push(ally)
      pokemon_array = []
      $player.party.each { |pkmn| pokemon_array.push(pkmn) }
      party_starts.push(pokemon_array.length)
      ally.party.each { |pkmn| pokemon_array.push(pkmn) }
      setBattleRule("double") if $game_temp.battle_rules["size"].nil?
    end
    return trainer_array, ally_items, pokemon_array, party_starts
  end

producer.content:
def pbRegisterPartner(tr_type, tr_name, tr_id = 0)
  tr_type = GameData::TrainerType.get(tr_type).id
  pbCancelVehicles
  trainer = pbLoadTrainer(tr_type, tr_name, tr_id)
  EventHandlers.trigger(:on_trainer_load, trainer)
  trainer.party.each do |i|
    i.owner = Pokemon::Owner.new_from_trainer(trainer)
    i.calc_stats
  end
  $PokemonGlobal.partner = [tr_type, tr_name, trainer.id, trainer.party]
end

def pbDeregisterPartner
  $PokemonGlobal.partner = nil
end

facts.fact: pbCanDoubleBattle? returns true if player.able_pokemon_count>=2; otherwise registered partner && count>=1. pbCanTripleBattle? analogous >=3, otherwise registered partner && count>=2. This checks presence, not partner alive count, actual partner_can_participate result or full layout legality. Ruby fallback may be nil, not normalized false.

partner_can_participate? rejects absent partner or noPartner rule first. More than1 foe Pokemon then admits regardless of size rule; with <=1 foe and size rule, single or /^1v/i rejects, any other truthy size admits; otherwise false. Do not reverse early multi-foe and later size branches.

set_up starts trainer_array=[$player], pokemon_array=$player.party alias, starts=[0], ally_items=[]. Eligible partner creates NPCTrainer from tuple name/type, sets ally.id=tuple[2], ally.party=tuple[3]. Re-queries GameData::Trainer.try_get(tuple[0],tuple[1],tuple[2]); ally_items[1]=data&.items.clone || []. Adds ally, allocates new merged Pokemon array with original same Pokemon refs; partner start after player length; appends ally party; only nil size rule triggers setBattleRule(double). No-partner path retains party array alias.

pbRegisterPartner first strict-normalizes TrainerType, then cancels vehicles, loads trainer(type,name,tr_id), triggers on_trainer_load, each party Pokemon replaces owner with new_from_trainer and calc_stats, then assigns global partner=[normalized input type,input name,trainer.id,trainer.party]. Third stored entry is trainer.id, not necessarily original tr_id dataset version. set_up later uses that stored entry both ally.id and third try_get argument exactly as source. pbDeregisterPartner only assigns nil.
facts.failure_prefix: Vehicle cancellation precedes loader failure; load callback/earlier member owner/stats writes precede final partner assignment; final global record is not committed if earlier step raises.
